messages:
Olivia Chen: Heads up — nightly forecast export under-reported Dedicated GPU hours for 2024-09-02 (~6.8% delta). Saw a spike in consumer retries and a cluster rebalance around 01:50Z. Putting notes here for infra + dataops sync.
ingest-bot: alert: forecast-export-run failed 2024-09-02T01:51Z -> kafka-consumer error (OffsetOutOfRange) then retried. Log: /var/log/forecast/export-2024-09-02.err

Marcus - dataops: Can someone paste an example raw event that's missing attribution? Need to confirm if tenant_id or org_id is missing at produce time.

Olivia Chen: sample from usage-raw (redacted):
```
{"ts":1938798600, "node":"nvidia-a100-7", "gpu_ms":900000, "org_id":null, "type":"gpu_heartbeat"}
```
Aggregator SQL for daily totals (current job):
```
SELECT COALESCE(org_id, 'UNKNOWN') AS org_id, SUM(gpu_ms)/3600000.0 AS gpu_hours
FROM forecast_raw.usage_events
WHERE type='gpu_heartbeat' AND ts >= date_trunc('day', now() - interval '1 day')
GROUP BY COALESCE(org_id, 'UNKNOWN');
```

Sana K: Observed export lag jump ~22m at 01:48Z. Consumer group forecast-export-consumer had partition 7 stuck on retries. Broker metrics show a large compacted message for partition 7 at ~01:46Z (size ~12MB) which triggered a fetch failure on consumers with low fetch.max.bytes.

Jess: Partition 7 has been on leader rotation due to AWS maintenance window. Quick remediations: increase fetch.max.bytes for the consumer to 20MB, and bump export timeout from 20m -> 60m while we stabilise. Also add a short-circuit in the aggregator to increment forecast.ingest.unattributed_events and route those to a tombstone topic for manual review.

Rui (eng-platform): Long-term fixes: enforce producer-side enrichment via the sidecar before writing to usage-raw. Options:
- validate Avro schema at producer with required org_id/tenant_id
- add small in-proc cache of node->owner mapping in producers to avoid downstream backfill
I'll own the sidecar change behind feature flag forecast_producer_enforce_org. Estimate 3h dev + 1h rollout.

Marcus - dataops: For immediate recovery I will run a targeted replay for partitions 7..9 for window 2024-09-02T01:30Z..2024-09-02T02:30Z. Plan: run replay-runner --topic usage-raw --partitions 7-9 --from 1938797400 --to 1938801000 --enrich-with node_owner_map. Estimated compute cost: 9 GPU-minutes on replay cluster (small job). I'll emit metric forecast.ingest.attribution_gap_ratio after replay.

Matt R.: Add a light sampling config so massive tenants don't blow export: forecast_ingest_sampling.default=0.01; if tenant_vcpu_minutes>5000/day -> sample 0.05. Controlled by feature flag forecast_ingest_sampling.

Olivia Chen: Good. Please add dashboard panels so product/support can monitor:
- "Forecast export consumer lag (p50/p95) by partition"
- "Unattributed events (count) — rolling 24h"
- "Recomputed GPU hours vs reported (tenant delta)"

Sana K: Consumer debug command I used: 
```
kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic usage-raw --partition 7 --offset 1254321 --max-messages 200 | jq -c 'select(.org_id==null)'
```

Jess: Rolling the fetch.max.bytes and timeout now (small change). Also added a defensive filter in the aggregator to route null-org events to forecast.unattributed for visibility instead of silently aggregating as UNKNOWN. Patch in 7m.

ingest-bot: forecast-export-run retried and completed 2024-09-02T03:10Z (duration 1h19m), summary: exported=1.8M events, unattributed=3.9k, replay_candidates=4.1k

Marcus - dataops: Replay started 2024-09-02T03:20Z -> progress 30% after 40m. No schema mismatches. Generated backfill report: predicted correction +6.9% overall on dedicated clusters for the day. Attaching short report to ticket.

Rui (eng-platform): I opened PR for producer-side validation and local node->owner caching, flagged for review. Will tag @Jess for rollout orchestration.

Matt R.: Alert rule proposal: forecast.ingest.attribution_gap_ratio > 0.05 for 45m -> paging to infra-oncall + dataops. Also add warning level at 2% -> slack-only to #product-alerts.

Olivia Chen: Thanks. Marcus, include exact replay compute cost and checkpoints in the backfill ticket so we can abort if errors spike. Everyone react with :thumbsup: when you ack.

Jess: Patch deployed (timeout + fetch.max.bytes) and aggregator routing change live. Monitoring panels added.

Marcus - dataops: Replay completed 2024-09-02T04:25Z. Final numbers: replayed=4.1k events enriched, corrected_gpu_hours=+6.87% for Dedicated pool, compute_cost_estimate=0.15 CPU-hours on replay cluster, note: low overhead.

Olivia Chen: Closing the thread — will keep an eye on attribution_gap_ratio in the morning. Great work.
